svg.title: Tic-Tac: game 1, move 1
svg.desc: Game 1 of @tannergolden against GitHub, @tannergolden plays X and GitHub O, under the Ghost Rule. Ghosts lock e5 and d2. After G... d2, the Arbiter's move for GitHub: a ghost locks the left edge of the bottom board. The Arbiter drew GitHub to make the first mark. It is GitHub's turn as O, in any open board, due by 31 Oct. Boards won: X 0, O 0.
